scope: Read-only smoke of an existing cached real cube; artificial cube-centre coordinate, no soma/anatomical acceptance

geometry.coordinate_frame: native microscopy acquisition XYZ; anatomical orientation and laterality unverified
geometry.spacing_status: nominal repository configuration; not independently calibrated
geometry.index_convention: XYZ index=(native_um-origin_um)/spacing_um; Z section filename index maps to index*spacing_z; no axis flip
geometry.missing_data_policy: reject missing central data; partial zero-filled gaps only with explicit allow_partial=True
